footer_links.title: Terms and Conditions
footer_links.leading_paragraph: Effective Date: October 2024. These Terms govern your access to Pub Quiz live trivia sessions and related services.
footer_links.content:
## Acceptance & Eligibility

By creating a screen name, joining a room PIN, or hosting a session you agree to these Terms. You must be at least **13 years old** or have guardian consent where required by law.

### Ways to participate

1. Continue as a guest with an anonymous session.
2. Sign in with a federated identity provider.
3. Enter a valid six-digit room PIN supplied by a host.

## Gameplay & Fair Play

Answer submissions are scored using **server-side timestamps**. Attempting to manipulate timers, share answer keys during an active round, or disrupt other players may result in removal from a room.

- Respect other players and hosts.
- Do not automate answer submissions.
- Report suspected cheating to [support@pubquiz.app](mailto:support@pubquiz.app).

## Telemetry We Record

We log *latency measurements*, ephemeral match metadata, and leaderboard aggregates needed to operate real-time trivia. Match data is retained only as long as needed to display results and comply with legal requests.

> Telemetry stays on our servers until the room closes, then ages out on a defined schedule.

## Third-Party Sub-processors

Identity flows may use `FirebaseUI`. Game state is stored in Google Cloud Firestore. Each provider processes data under its own terms while acting on our instructions.

## Contact

Questions about these Terms can be sent to [legal@pubquiz.app](mailto:legal@pubquiz.app) or read alongside our [Privacy Policy](/privacy).

footer_links.title: Privacy Policy
footer_links.leading_paragraph: Effective Date: October 2024. Pub Quiz is committed to protecting your privacy and handling player telemetry transparently.
footer_links.content:
## Information We Collect

When you authenticate, lock a screen name, or play in live rounds we collect authentication identifiers, your chosen handle, answer submission timestamps, points awarded, and room connection metadata.

### Categories of data

- **Authentication data** passed through federated providers.
- **Gameplay telemetry** such as response latency and ephemeral match data.
- **Invitation dispatches** used solely to transmit join links.

## FirebaseUI and Cloud Firestore

Authentication is rendered through **FirebaseUI**. Session and gameplay documents are persisted in **Cloud Firestore**. We maintain **zero monetization** of player contact information and do not sell personal data.

## How We Use Data

1. Synchronize live quiz rounds and leaderboards.
2. Detect abuse and protect fair play.
3. Respond to verified legal requests.

Learn more about Google Cloud security at [https://cloud.google.com/security](https://cloud.google.com/security).

## Your Data Rights

You may request **erasure** of your account history, **portability** exports of your match log, and object to processing where applicable privacy laws grant those rights.

## Contact

Privacy inquiries can be submitted to [privacy@pubquiz.app](mailto:privacy@pubquiz.app).
